name: Handcuffed
source:
In this game you have to live a couple of days in the face of a boring Japanese girl. But suddenly an unexpected human bursts into her life...

[from [url=https://yuuitsu.itch.io/handcuffed]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个游戏中，你必须面对一个无聊的日本女孩几天。但突然，一个意想不到的人闯入了她的生活……

[来自[url=https://yuuitsu.itch.io/handcuffed]Itch.io[/url]]
